steps.what: Retrieve the actual property valuation, security description and lender collateral policy
Calculate indicative loan amounts from the checked property value and applicable collateral limits
Assess property liquidity, valuation uncertainty and security limitations to choose the recommended loan amount
Write the actual loan recommendation with property identity, calculation, qualifications and reasons
Review the exact final loan recommendation and recipient before authorizing its professional release
Send the exact authorized property collateral recommendation to the instructed lender contact
Save the loan recommendation in its existing appraisal file

tasks.design: Configure linked source references and checked collateral-limit calculations in {SPREADSHEET}, then populate the existing recommendation template in {DOCS}. The appraiser retains valuation interpretation, the amount recommendation and the full final release check; {EMAIL} sends only the exact authorized snapshot to the checked recipient.
tasks.previous_blocker: Valuation references, policy limits and recommendation documents can require repeated manual navigation and copying.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked cells, protected formulas and document fields can remove those repeated actions without a credit-decision model.
tasks.still_hard: A market value does not establish realizable security value or a suitable lending decision. Unusual property, uncertain title and illiquid markets need professional assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The appraiser explains uncertainty and chooses a defensible collateral recommendation. The lender retains its credit decision.

ambition.what: The same collateral recommendation is prepared with fewer repeated calculations and copied fields.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checked spreadsheet formulas and linked document fields can calculate policy-based collateral limits and populate a recommendation; they do not establish the professional valuation or decide credit.

assumptions: Boundary: an appraiser uses an existing valuation to recommend a loan amount against property, including the actual written recommendation and its delivery. Producing the original valuation and the lender's credit approval belong to separate tasks, not missing free inputs created here.

The valuation's actual producer supplies property identifier, valuation date, currency, value basis, appraised value and stated qualifications. The lender supplies the applicable policy version, collateral category and permitted ratio or deduction. The appraiser's existing source reading, checking and manual entry are counted in s1; unclear or non-tabular terms remain manual and are not forced into a formula.

Test existing spreadsheet formulas and document fields first. s2 represents manual ratio, deduction and comparison work only where it actually occurs today; native calculation runtime already present earns no saving. All proposed amounts remain indicative until s3.

s1 removes 3 of its 15 units of repeated source navigation and retains 12 for reading and checking. s4 removes 6 of 20 units of repeated property identifiers, dates, calculation copying and page layout; the substantive reasons and qualifications retain 14 units. These are unmeasured design estimates, not observed baselines.

s5 is the appraiser's actual final professional release check, not an added supervisory approval or a gate on authoring a note. Its exact recipient, amount, qualifications, attachment and version bind a1; any change voids release authorization. s6 is the real email preparation and send, not a same-system save.

The existing appraisal file is read for later valuation enquiries and audit. Its ordinary same-system save needs no approval and earns no saving; the schema's minimum 1 unit conservatively retains its near-zero time. Do not add another record where the actual workflow keeps none.

Machine calculation and send failures stop. The retained s3 and s5 checks cover source and calculation validity; incremental upkeep includes broken field and failed delivery repair. No work is transferred to the lender or valuation producer to obtain the claimed gain.
unknowns: Whether the current calculation is already native and automatic
The actual policy terms and property categories eligible for fixed calculations
The real final release and delivery route
Actual time spent copying fields versus substantive qualification
research_questions: Observe a real appraisal-to-collateral recommendation and identify repeated manual calculation and copying.
Can every policy limit and output value be traced to a dated source, including nonstandard collateral?
Test a changed valuation, missing currency, incompatible policy and failed delivery; confirm the exact release authorization is invalidated when required.

already_counted.description: Source checks, collateral judgement, substantive writing, final professional review and ordinary file persistence are retained in the indicated steps.

incremental.description: Maintain policy/formula mappings and document fields, and repair failed calculations or delivery links beyond the retained case review.

approvals.approved_version: Exact s5-authorized recommendation attachment and lender recipient snapshot; any content, amount, qualification or recipient change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=12+0+30+14+10+0+1=67. Gross saving 33, less 3 incremental upkeep gives net 30. Conservative case: unusual property has no usable policy table, retaining 18 of s2's 20 units; a nonstandard report retains 19 of s4's 20 and unindexed references retain 14 of s1's 15. The real send still removes 4 units: 2+1+1+4=8 gross, less 5 upkeep for the exceptional mappings gives 3. This is a task-specific eligibility scenario, not a percentage reduction of the central gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The appraiser keeps responsibility for valuation interpretation and the recommended collateral amount; repeated arithmetic and document fields take less time.
skills_to_grow: Test collateral policy formulas against original terms
Explain valuation uncertainty and realizable security limitations
Check exact document versions and release recipients
role.ambitious_version: Provide a traceable collateral recommendation whose figures, professional qualifications and release version are clear to the lender.
